# Knowledge and Wisdom

**Knowledge** is information that has been connected, generalized, and made
actionable — the "how". It links facts into models you can reuse.

**Wisdom** is knowledge applied with judgement — the "why" and "whether". It
weighs trade-offs and chooses well under uncertainty.

These are the upper two layers of the [[DIKW Overview]]; they build directly on
the foundation laid in [[Data and Information]].
